symptoms.label: Age
symptoms.description: Age in completed years.

symptoms.label: Sudden vision loss
symptoms.description: A sudden major loss or darkening of vision in one or both eyes.

symptoms.label: New vision change
symptoms.description: A new reduction, blur, distortion, or other change in vision.

symptoms.label: Severe eye pain
symptoms.description: Eye pain described as severe or difficult to tolerate.

symptoms.label: Eye redness
symptoms.description: Visible redness of the white of the eye.

symptoms.label: Eye discharge
symptoms.description: Watery, mucus-like, or pus-like material coming from the eye.

symptoms.label: Eye itching
symptoms.description: A prominent urge to rub or scratch the eyes.

symptoms.label: Burning sensation
symptoms.description: A burning or stinging feeling on the eye surface.

symptoms.label: Gritty feeling
symptoms.description: A sandy or foreign-body sensation without a known injury.

symptoms.label: Watery eyes
symptoms.description: More tearing or watering than usual.

symptoms.label: Crusting at eyelashes
symptoms.description: Flakes or crust around the eyelashes or eyelid margins.

symptoms.label: Painful eyelid lump
symptoms.description: A localized tender or painful bump on an eyelid.

symptoms.label: Painless eyelid lump
symptoms.description: A localized eyelid bump that is not painful.

symptoms.label: Distance blur
symptoms.description: Difficulty seeing distant objects clearly.

symptoms.label: Near blur
symptoms.description: Difficulty seeing reading material or other near objects clearly.

symptoms.label: Gradual cloudy vision
symptoms.description: Vision becoming cloudy, hazy, or faded over time.

symptoms.label: Glare or halos
symptoms.description: Troublesome glare or rings around lights.

symptoms.label: Central distortion
symptoms.description: Straight lines look wavy or the central view is newly distorted.

symptoms.label: Peripheral vision change
symptoms.description: A gradual concern about side or peripheral vision.

symptoms.label: Family history of glaucoma
symptoms.description: A close biological relative has had glaucoma.

symptoms.label: Diabetes
symptoms.description: The person has been told by a health professional that they have diabetes.

symptoms.label: Sudden new floaters
symptoms.description: A sudden increase or shower of spots, specks, or cobweb shapes in vision.

symptoms.label: Flashes of light
symptoms.description: New flashes or streaks of light not caused by an external light source.

symptoms.label: Curtain or shadow
symptoms.description: A curtain-like shadow or dark area moving across the field of vision.

symptoms.label: Contact-lens use
symptoms.description: Contact lenses are currently worn or were worn when symptoms began.

symptoms.label: Light sensitivity
symptoms.description: Light causes unusual discomfort or pain.

symptoms.label: Headache with nausea or vomiting
symptoms.description: Eye symptoms occur with headache and nausea or vomiting.

symptoms.label: Chemical exposure
symptoms.description: A chemical, cleaner, fuel, or other irritating substance entered the eye.

symptoms.label: High-speed impact
symptoms.description: The eye was struck by a fast-moving object or fragment.

symptoms.label: Embedded object
symptoms.description: An object appears stuck in or penetrating the eye.

symptoms.label: Recent eye injury
symptoms.description: Symptoms started after a blow, scratch, fall, or other eye injury.

symptoms.label: Allergy association
symptoms.description: Symptoms started with a known allergy exposure or seasonal allergy flare.

symptoms.label: Recent respiratory illness
symptoms.description: A cold, sore throat, or respiratory illness occurred near the start of the eye symptoms.

symptoms.label: Both eyes affected
symptoms.description: Symptoms affect both eyes rather than only one.

symptoms.label: Worse during screen or prolonged near work
symptoms.description: Symptoms tend to increase during prolonged screen or near tasks.

symptoms.label: Symptom onset
symptoms.description: How quickly the current eye concern began.
